originalSourceText:
Q.6   Suppose a decoder generates three tokens with conditional probabilities:
                                   𝑃(𝑦1|𝑋) = 0.5
                                     𝑃(𝑦2|𝑦1, 𝑋) = 0.4
                                   𝑃(𝑦3|𝑦1, 𝑦2, 𝑋) = 0.2
     What is the probability assigned to the complete three-token sequence?

      (A) 0.1

      (B) 0.11

      (C) 0.04

      (D) 1.1

       Explanation: 𝑃(𝑦1, 𝑦2, 𝑦3|𝑋) = 0.5 × 0.4 × 0.2 = 0.04
      Sentence probability is the product of the conditional probabilities of successive
       outputs.
      Refer slide 23 of Lecture 48: AI based Speech Recognition
